node.statement: Exterior sign-union contribution is O(tau). For the nonactor support fibers, the aggregated negative coefficients over the sign-union are bounded by the per-row negative-mass cap t (mass split, previous steps), while the ℓ¹ scaling shows each unit of x-displacement of such a fiber costs tau of the row's ℓ¹ extent, which is at most 1+2t in total. Consequently the total transverse moment the confined exterior fibers can supply is at most a constant multiple of tau.
